data.name: AppHome_Intro
data.value: This is the empty shell of the product app. The dashboard and the modules arrive in Milestones 5 and 6.

data.name: AppHome_Modules_Intro
data.value: Every stage of the testing journey is a module behind a feature flag. A flag stays off until its module is built.

data.name: Reconnect_Failed
data.value: Could not reconnect. Please retry or reload the page.

data.name: Reconnect_Paused
data.value: The session was paused by the server.

data.name: Reconnect_ResumeFailed
data.value: Could not resume the session. Please retry or reload the page.

data.name: Account_SignIn_RememberMe
data.value: Stay signed in on this device

data.name: Account_SignIn_Failed
data.value: That email address and password do not match an account.

data.name: Account_SignIn_LockedOut
data.value: Too many attempts. Try again after {0}, or reset your password to get back in now.

data.name: Account_SignIn_NoMembership
data.value: This account does not belong to an organization. Ask an administrator to invite you.

data.name: Account_Forgot_Intro
data.value: Give us the address you sign in with and we will send a link to it.

data.name: Account_Forgot_Sent
data.value: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works once, and for two hours.

data.name: Account_Reset_Hint
data.value: At least 12 characters. Length is what matters; a phrase you will remember beats a short tangle of symbols.

data.name: Account_Reset_Done
data.value: Your password is saved. You can sign in with it now.

data.name: Account_TwoFactor_Intro
data.value: Open your authenticator app and type the six digits it shows.

data.name: Account_TwoFactor_Failed
data.value: That code is not right, or it has already expired. Try the next one.

data.name: Account_TwoFactor_SetupRequired
data.value: {0} requires a second factor. Setting one up is part of Milestone 4; until then, ask an administrator to turn the requirement off.

data.name: Account_Accept_NotUsable
data.value: This link no longer works. It may have been used already, withdrawn, or it may have expired. Ask for a new one.

data.name: Account_Accept_Done
data.value: You have joined {0}. Sign in to get started.

data.name: Account_Error_EmailRequired
data.value: Enter the address you sign in with.

data.name: Account_Error_CodeRequired
data.value: Enter the six digits from your authenticator app.

data.name: Account_Error_NameRequired
data.value: Enter the name your colleagues will see.

data.name: Password_PasswordTooShort
data.value: That password is too short. Twelve characters or more.

data.name: Password_Breached
data.value: That password appears in lists attackers already have. Choose another.

data.name: Password_PasswordRequiresUniqueChars
data.value: That password repeats too few different characters.

data.name: PasswordReset_Error_LinkNotUsable
data.value: This link no longer works. It may have been used already, or it may have expired. Ask for a new one.

data.name: Invitation_Error_NotUsable
data.value: This invitation no longer works. It may have been used already, withdrawn, or it may have expired.

data.name: Invitation_Error_AccountDetailsMissing
data.value: Give your name and choose a password to finish joining.

data.name: Password_NotAcceptable
data.value: That password cannot be used. Choose another.
